info.name: Creates or updates a drive. Pre-boot only.

params.name: drive_id
params.description: The id of the guest drive

items.docs: Creates new drive with ID specified by drive_id path parameter. If a drive with the specified ID already exists, updates its state based on new input. Will fail if update is not possible.

info.name: Updates the properties of a drive. Post-boot only.

params.name: drive_id
params.description: The id of the guest drive

items.docs: Updates the properties of the drive with the ID specified by drive_id path parameter. Will fail if update is not possible.
